name: Chronicle
about: A theme that is always there to pick on the Theme page (see launcher_theme.py and README.txt in this folder): the launcher as an old illustrated chronicle of Vana'diel: tooled leather, gold leaf, aged vellum, the official pencil sketches printed into the page and illuminated red capitals. Its buttons are the pictures in the chronicle-ui folder and its banners the chronicle_*__theme-chronicle pictures (art-src\scripts\chron_buttons.py and chron_banners.py draw them, from the concept art in art-src\newart). Lettering in the pictures is Cinzel, Cinzel Decorative and IM FELL English (art-src\fonts, SIL Open Font License); the launcher's own text stays in the usual font (Segoe UI on Windows). It was the standard look from 2026-11-24 until Windurst took over on 2026-11-25; it stays pickable on the Theme page. Its song is JØ's "Roots".
